# VoltaMission

> Technical sourcing and qualification for battery cells, fuel-cell components, and equipment. North American hardware teams and research groups hire VoltaMission to find and technically vet hard-to-source parts that distributors won't supply. Not a reseller — clients pay for engineering judgment from people who have built cell and laser manufacturing lines.

## What VoltaMission does
- Hard-to-find battery cell & component sourcing (non-catalog, small / R&D volume)
- Technical vendor qualification (specs, manufacturing capability, samples, NDAA-aware origin compliance)
- Cross-border sourcing support (NA + Asia, overseas QC, bilingual EN/Mandarin negotiation)

## Who it's for
- Hardware startups stuck sourcing non-catalog or allocation-gated cells
- Research groups needing small / R&D-volume parts with provenance documentation
- North American manufacturers sourcing from Asia who need a trusted technical intermediary

## Key pages
- Home: https://voltamission.com/
- Contact: info@voltamission.com
- Free tools: Laser Parameter Calculator, Speed Match Simulator, Tension Control Simulator

## Location
Toronto, Canada. Serves North America and Asia.
